title: Pre-verbal strategy readouts in minimal algebraic pairs
description: Observation phase for the commitment-gap program. Constants 5, 6 and 7 change the preferred solution procedure while prompt structure remains closely matched.

hypothesis.primary: Method-specific readouts group by the algebraic procedure actually executed before method-specific surface vocabulary appears.
falsifiers: Readouts group primarily by lexical prompt similarity rather than by executed procedure.
Method classification falls to chance when method words are forbidden or used as distractors.
The apparent signal begins only after the model has already emitted method-specific words.
exploratory: Estimate readability onset R and verbalization onset V.
Compare Jacobian/Logit disagreement near the strategy transition.

chat.content: Solve x^2 - 5x + {{constant}} = 0. Explain the solution clearly.
Solve x^2 - 5x + {{constant}} = 0. Show only algebraic transformations and the roots. Never name the method.
The phrase 'quadratic formula' is a distractor in this instruction. Solve x^2 - 5x + {{constant}} = 0 using the simplest valid procedure, without discussing the distractor.

metadata.condition: method phrase present as a decoy

exclusions: Runs that fail to solve the equation
Positions after the first method-specific surface token for the primary analysis
Byte-identical canonical results beyond the first stored observation
analysis.notes: The causal commitment point C is not claimed in this observation-only experiment.

stopping_rule: Complete the locked matrix. Publish positive, mixed or null results.
